#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import math
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# paths
t06_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t06_stop_service_intensity.csv")
t09_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t09_poi_nearest_stop.csv")
out_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t10_accessibility_scores.csv")

# read input files
t06 = pd.read_csv(t06_path)
t09 = pd.read_csv(t09_path)

# keep only needed columns from t06
t06_needed = t06[["stop_id", "n_departures", "n_routes"]]

# merge nearest stop info
df = t09.merge(t06_needed, how="left", left_on="nearest_stop_id", right_on="stop_id")

# compute additional columns
df["log_departures"] = np.log1p(df["n_departures"])
df["log_routes"] = np.log1p(df["n_routes"])

max_log_departures = df["log_departures"].max()
max_log_routes = df["log_routes"].max()

# calculate accessibility score
# part 1: distance
dist_factor = 0.5 * np.maximum(
    0,
    1 - np.minimum(df["distance_m"], 1000) / 1000
)

# part 2: departures
dep_factor = 0.35 * df["log_departures"] / max_log_departures

# part 3: routes
route_factor = 0.15 * df["log_routes"] / max_log_routes

df["accessibility_score"] = dist_factor + dep_factor + route_factor

# select required columns
out_df = df[["qid", "label", "poi_type", "distance_m", "n_departures", "n_routes", "accessibility_score"]]

# ensure RFC4180 compliance by using default quoting (QUOTE_MINIMAL)
out_df.to_csv(out_path, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
</solution_file>
